summary: Iteration 8 – validated the 3 user-reported fixes on 'Conoscenza Aperta': (1) share buttons now display clean 'WhatsApp' and 'Telegram' text with the FontAwesome6 brand glyphs (whatsapp \uf232 + telegram \uf2c6) rendering correctly even on web preview — no 'bomba'/'telegramma' or 💣/📮 fallback anywhere; testIDs share-wa / share-tg still present and tappable. (2) Full IT ⇄ EN toggle propagates across Home, Library, Media, Profile and Article detail: IT default shows 'Sapienza per crescere', 'Cerca articoli, meditazioni…' placeholder, 'Ultimi articoli', 'Biblioteca'+'Tutte' chip, 'Meditazioni & Video'+'Tutti/Meditazioni/Video' chips, 'Preferiti', 'Il tuo percorso' with 'Articoli letti/Min. meditati/Giorni di fila', 'Invita e guadagna', 'Lingua'; after switching to English via Profilo→Lingua, all corresponding labels flip to 'Wisdom to grow', 'Search articles, meditations…', 'Latest articles', 'Library'+'All', 'Meditations & Videos'+'All/Meditations/Videos', 'Favorites', 'Your journey' with 'Articles read/Min. meditated/Day streak', 'Invite & earn', 'Language'; category chips also translate (Personal Growth, Spiritual, Philosophy, Psychology, Nutrition, Videos). (3) OG share pages are now gated invitation pages: GET /api/share/article/{id} returns text/html with the exact phrase 'Iscriviti per leggere' AND a href='conoscenzaaperta://register?...' deep link; media share renders 'Iscriviti per ascoltare la meditazione' for kind=meditation and 'Iscriviti per guardare il video' for kind=video; all OG meta tags (og:title/description/image/url/type) and twitter:card=summary_large_image still present; og:description is a truncated teaser (≤220 chars ending with …) rather than the full ~2300-char summary; unknown ids return 404. Backend: 13/13 pytest pass in test_iteration8_share_gated_and_i18n.py. No deprecated Expo packages, no red screens, only the harmless expo-notifications web warning. Regression sanity: /search 200, /me/stats 200, /favorites/toggle 200, /admin/stats/summary 200, checkout with LANCIO2026 discounts 12m plan to 720€.
action_items: No fixes required — all 3 reported bugs are verified fixed end-to-end.
Optional (not blocking): media detail 'views' pluralization is 'X views' even for X=1 in both IT and EN — consider a singular/plural i18n key if strict copy matters.
Optional: iteration_7 note about server.py length (~1764 lines) still applies — future refactor into routers/ (share/, admin/, billing/, content/) is recommended but not blocking.
Optional: OG share page uses og:type='article' also for media share URLs — if strict semantics matter, switch to og:type='video.other' inside share_media_page. Not required by user reports.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1481-1541 _og_html renders the gated CTA correctly with HTML-escaped fields and a deep-link 'conoscenzaaperta://register?ref=…' — matches app.json scheme update.
server.py:1485 description teaser truncates on last space + adds '…' when >220 chars — safe against emoji/CJK boundaries because .rsplit(' ',1) is on the substring, not the full text.

frontend/app/article/[id].tsx:167-174 uses FontAwesome6 brand icons with iconStyle='brand' and Text with allowFontScaling=false + accessibilityLanguage='en' — this is the correct API and prevents OS-level auto-translation of 'WhatsApp'/'Telegram' to 'bomba'/'telegramma'.
src/i18n.ts covers all newly-added keys used on Home/Library/Media/Profile/Article/Media detail; catLabel translation of category chips also works.
app.json:8 scheme 'conoscenzaaperta' matches the deep-link href emitted by /api/share/*.
Media share endpoint still emits og:type='article'; not a defect but semantically it could be 'video.other' for kind=video.

rca_of_issue: N/A — all three reported bugs are validated as fixed. Fix recap: (1) WhatsApp/Telegram labels: replaced emoji glyphs (which iOS/Android sometimes replaced with 💣 bomba / 📮 telegramma due to font-substitution + auto-translate) with FontAwesome6 brand icons plus plain-text 'WhatsApp'/'Telegram' Text nodes carrying allowFontScaling=false and accessibilityLanguage='en' — bypasses OS translation and font substitution. (2) i18n: /app/frontend/src/i18n.ts extended with ~50 new keys covering Home tagline/search/latest_articles, Library title/all, Media title+kind chips, Profile favorites/journey/streak/invite/language, Article source/comments/send/write_comment, Media minutes/views/reads/premium; catLabel mapping translates category chips. (3) Gated share page: _og_html now renders a dark-themed page with an 'Iscriviti per {leggere|ascoltare la meditazione|guardare il video}' CTA and a 'conoscenzaaperta://register?ref=…' deep-link button while keeping the full OG + twitter:card meta so WhatsApp/Telegram unfurl a proper preview card; app.json scheme updated from 'frontend' to 'conoscenzaaperta' so the deep link resolves in a native build.
